title: Document emergent sample-invalidated-or-replayed dependency in floor-raise test
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:948 + stratum.py:438-439,609-610: the pinned 'sample-invalidated-or-replayed' reason for adopt/consider is emergent, not direct — the candidate is issued (seq 2, samples.py:341-342) before the call, and _clear_locked's eager invalidation bumps __issuance_high_water to _latest_issuance_sequence() (=2), so the reject fires at stratum.py:609-610 before _rejection's 'below-epoch-floor' (stratum.py:145). Deterministic, but the dependency chain is undocumented; add a one-line comment citing stratum.py:438-439 to prevent a future 'why is this the reason?' fix.
